# OlivERP

> OlivERP is an open-source online ERP for small businesses and independent sellers to manage sales, purchases, stock, VAT, expenses, and financial summaries without accounting-heavy workflows.

OlivERP offers English and Spanish interfaces, a read-only demo, and a documented project-scoped API for scripts, n8n, Make, AI agents, and other integrations. The product is under active development, so interfaces, the data model, and the API may change.

## Product guide

- [OlivERP overview](https://oliverp.4oli.com/index.md): Concise, LLM-friendly product facts, modules, API capabilities, audiences, and limits.
- [OlivERP](https://oliverp.4oli.com/): English product page and app entry point.
- [OlivERP in Spanish](https://oliverp.4oli.com/es): Spanish product page.
- [Public documentation](https://oliverp.4oli.com/documentation): User guide, API reference, and private GitHub plugin documentation.
- [Spanish documentation](https://oliverp.4oli.com/es/documentation): Spanish versions of the public guides.
